title: ASRock GPU No POST
shortDescription: PC powers on but ASRock card outputs no signal.
fullDescription: Often a power cable issue or BIOS too old to recognize the card. Check 8-pin and reflash motherboard BIOS.

fixSteps.title: Reseat 8-pin
fixSteps.instruction: Verify all PCIe power connectors clicked in.

fixSteps.title: Update BIOS
fixSteps.instruction: Use iGPU output to flash latest motherboard BIOS.

faq.a: Yes for Arc; recommended for AMD.

title: Fan Bearing Noise
fullDescription: Cheaper hub-fans on AIB cards can develop bearing noise. RMA or DIY swap with same hub fan.

fixSteps.title: RMA card
fixSteps.instruction: Within warranty, RMA via ASRock support.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan
fixSteps.instruction: Order matching 4-pin fan and swap on shroud.

faq.a: Sealed bearings rarely benefit from oil.

title: ASRock Tweak Software Crashes
fullDescription: ASRock Tweak conflicts with MSI Afterburner. Uninstall conflicting OC tools.

title: Polychrome RGB Not Working on GPU
shortDescription: ASRock GPU LEDs do not light.
fullDescription: Polychrome software must run as admin and only one RGB tool at a time.

title: VRM Hotspot Trip
fullDescription: Phantom Gaming VRM can run hot. Improve case airflow and replace VRM thermal pads if persistent.

fixSteps.title: DDU clean install
fixSteps.instruction: Safe Mode > DDU > install latest AMD/Intel driver.

title: Coil Whine at High FPS
shortDescription: Buzz from inductors at uncapped framerates.
fullDescription: Cap framerate to monitor refresh to silence whine.

fixSteps.title: Cap FPS
fixSteps.instruction: Use AMD Chill or Intel Smooth Sync at refresh rate.

title: DisplayPort Flickers Black
shortDescription: Monitor briefly goes black at desktop.
fullDescription: DP 1.4 cable quality matters; cheap cables drop signal.

fixSteps.title: Disable FreeSync
fixSteps.instruction: Toggle FreeSync off in driver settings.

faq.a: Sometimes a workaround for FreeSync issues.

title: BIOS Switch in Wrong Position
fullDescription: Phantom Gaming has Quiet/OC BIOS toggle; setting changes only after full power off.

fixSteps.title: Full power off
fixSteps.instruction: Shut down PC, flip switch, restart.

faq.a: Lower fan curve, slightly lower power limit.

title: Heavy Card Causes Sag
fullDescription: Heavy 3-fan cards bend. Use included anti-sag bracket or third-party support.

fixSteps.title: Install GPU brace
fixSteps.instruction: Use bundled or aftermarket anti-sag bracket.
